title: Diffusion of Innovations 5th ed.
claim_supported: Adopter categories; diffusion through communication channels and social systems
caveat: Framework describes diffusion timing; does not by itself establish adopters as causal co-producers

author_or_org: Michael L. Katz and Carl Shapiro
title: Network Externalities Competition and Compatibility
claim_supported: Network value and compatibility can depend on installed base and expectations
caveat: Network effects should not be asserted for products whose value does not increase with participation

title: Competing Technologies Increasing Returns and Lock-In by Historical Events
claim_supported: Increasing returns can produce path dependence and lock-in
caveat: Historical lock-in does not prove an inferior technology always wins

title: Pebble E-Paper Watch for iPhone and Android — Kickstarter
claim_supported: $10,266,845 pledged by 68,929 backers against $100,000 goal
caveat: Crowdfunding support is not equivalent to durable retail demand

title: The Secret Tesla Motors Master Plan
claim_supported: Tesla explicitly described entering at high end and using revenue toward lower-priced products
caveat: Company strategy statement is evidence of intended mechanism not proof that revenue alone caused later affordability

title: Tesla Motors Begins Regular Production of 2008 Tesla Roadster
claim_supported: Roadster regular production and more than 900 reservations
caveat: Corporate press release; use for dated operational facts not independent evaluation

title: Tesla Motors Completes All Regulatory Approvals and Sets Schedule to Begin Production
claim_supported: Roadster regulatory approvals and interim transmission detail
caveat: Illustrates unfinished early production; company source

title: Clean Energy Innovation — Moving down the learning curve
claim_supported: Learning curves combine learning-by-researching doing standardization collaboration and scale; historical PV and Li-ion learning rates
caveat: Learning rates are empirical historical relationships and can change

title: Factors Affecting the Cost of Airplanes
claim_supported: Foundational empirical production learning-curve work
caveat: Historical aircraft evidence should not be generalized mechanically to every technology

title: Sticky Information and the Locus of Problem Solving
claim_supported: Problem-solving information can be costly to transfer and can locate innovation near users
caveat: Does not imply all user feedback is high quality

title: The Sources of Innovation
claim_supported: Lead users can experience needs ahead of the market and sometimes develop solutions
caveat: User innovation concentrated where user benefit justifies effort

title: Democratizing Innovation
claim_supported: User-centered and freely revealed innovation across software and physical products
caveat: Broad synthesis; domain-specific claims still require domain evidence

title: How to Develop Breakthrough Products and Services — lecture notes
claim_supported: Lead-user method; users as sources of innovation; trial-and-error and sticky information
caveat: Teaching material summarizes research; prefer underlying papers for formal citation

title: iPhone App Store Downloads Top 10 Million in First Weekend
claim_supported: More than 800 native apps and more than 10 million downloads in first weekend
caveat: Download volume does not establish healthy developer economics

title: IBM Annual Report 2000
claim_supported: IBM described a $1 billion Linux investment and 1,500 programmers to accelerate enterprise adoption
caveat: Company strategy source; not independent proof of Linux causal outcomes

author_or_org: Wesley M. Cohen and Daniel A. Levinthal
title: Absorptive Capacity: A New Perspective on Learning and Innovation
claim_supported: Organizations build ability to recognize assimilate and apply external knowledge through prior related knowledge
caveat: Conceptual and empirical organizational-learning support not a direct test of every technology-adoption claim

title: Bringing more of Google's productivity apps to Glass Enterprise
claim_supported: Glass Enterprise workplace deployments and hands-free communication/task use cases since 2017
caveat: Glass Enterprise hardware was later discontinued; use case persistence is not platform permanence

title: Agentic Payments: What Onchain Data Reveals Commerce
claim_supported: Visa/Artemis reported agents paying for travel inventory data and compute based on live onchain evidence
caveat: Early evidence; does not establish mainstream autonomous commerce

title: Mastercard launches Agent Pay for Machines
claim_supported: Permissioned programmatic machine payments including high-volume and very small-value transactions
caveat: Product announcement and ecosystem support do not measure adoption scale

title: The agentic commerce platform: Shopify connects any merchant to every AI conversation
claim_supported: Announcement of Universal Commerce Protocol co-developed with Google
caveat: Platform announcement; future impact remains uncertain

title: Under the Hood: Universal Commerce Protocol
claim_supported: UCP described as open-source common language and primitives for agentic commerce with existing infrastructure and multiple transports
caveat: Technical design and partner endorsement are not proof of eventual standard dominance

title: Agentic commerce for every developer: Spring '26 Edition
claim_supported: Shopify opened agentic-commerce infrastructure self-service to developers and described broad UCP support
caveat: Vendor source; partner/support statements should be date-stamped

title: Visa Partners with OpenAI to Power the Next Generation of AI Commerce
claim_supported: Visa/OpenAI collaboration around secure payments within agentic-commerce environments
caveat: Partnership announcement; does not prove transaction volume

title: Visa Opens the Door to AI-Driven Shopping for Businesses Worldwide
claim_supported: Intelligent Commerce Connect pilot and on-ramp framing for agent builders merchants and enablers
caveat: Pilot status must not be described as ubiquitous deployment

title: The new rules of the road for agentic commerce
claim_supported: Industry emphasis on standards trust and payment controls for agentic commerce
caveat: Thought-leadership framing; use mainly for contemporaneous design priorities

title: Agentic Commerce: The expanded payments economy
claim_supported: Visa argument that agentic systems can reduce friction and increase transaction density
caveat: Forward-looking company analysis rather than measured market outcome

title: Tesla Motors Receives $40 Million Financing Commitment
claim_supported: More than 1,200 Roadster deposits and financing intended partly to accelerate manufacturing and future development
caveat: Financing had multiple sources; customer deposits should not be presented as sole capital source

title: Tesla Motors Selects BorgWarner for Production of New Gearbox
claim_supported: Early Roadsters used interim transmission and customers could receive free upgrade
caveat: Useful example of first customers encountering product evolution; company source

title: Take Advantage practical adoption synthesis
claim_supported: Reversible experiments transferable learning capability-over-vendor and exit criteria
caveat: Normative synthesis; intentionally not presented as empirically universal scoring formula
